audio: not run because the downstream network rejected the call before answer
durability: one stored intent converged once from pending to failed without automatic redial
implementation_finding: A wildcard SIP signaling listener had incorrectly reused its public advertised IP as the local RTP bind address.
implementation_fix: Connect now requires a concrete media_bind_ip for wildcard SIP listeners and keeps it separate from advertised signaling and media addresses.
claim_boundary: This proves local RTP allocation, Telnyx resolution, Digest authentication, outbound INVITE, carrier Trying and Ringing, and terminal failure convergence. It does not prove PSTN audio or an answered call.
